scope: Frozen Oct7 f9 counter/clock and new stage111 firmware source review only

provenance.limitation: Retained Oct7 snapshot, overlay manifest, compiler trace and routed result bind the inspected paths to this build; hashes newly calculated here are not claimed to be original Oct7 per-file hashes.

source_conclusions.main_clock: Fixed MMCM multiply5/divide1/divide20; DRP, dynamic phase and powerdown tied off; BUFG output; design nominal 50MHz is not an independent measured physical rate.
source_conclusions.cpu_cycle: 64-bit cycle_q advances once per main clock outside debug; no WFI/commit/privilege gate in increment; M-mode MCYCLE writes override; common reset clears.
source_conclusions.time: Unsupported native TIME is emulated by OpenSBI; host S-mode gets raw 64-bit CLINT mtime via MMIO, incremented at rtc/main-clock-div2 rising edges; no debug/WFI gate; MMIO mtime writes override and common reset clears.
source_conclusions.real_cpu_counter_reprogramming_path: Linux perf SBI SET_INIT_VALUE -> SBI PMU start -> csr_write_num(MCYCLE+cidx); no-MCOUNTINHIBIT skips inhibit handling but still writes initial value.
source_conclusions.ordinary_counter_reset_path: Finite ordinary only reads CYCLE/TIME; DMA observer reset and IOMMU HPM inhibit/save/restore operate separate MMIO counters, not MCYCLE/MTIME.
source_conclusions.two_windows: stage3 swapout and stage6 restore bracket phase() including instrumentation/control/polling/capture; CPU and TIME sample points are distinct; not pure DMA hardware delay.

stage_conversion.allowed: Conditional conversion of each counter's own raw stamp delta using accepted same-boot Dell calibration bounds.
shared_conditions: Actual same new boot/hart and assigned f9 BIT identity accepted by root
No reset/reconfiguration/clock stop or counter write during calibration through the reported stamp pair
Effective rate remains within applied Dell-relative bounds during reported stamp pair; analog drift not established by static source
cpu_extra_conditions: No CPU perf/PMU mcycle initial-value write
stage_conversion.time_read_semantics: Actual sample lies in trap's CLINT MMIO read; trap and bus latency not bounded here; full CAPS command still brackets that event.
stage_conversion.preferred_wording: Instrumented ordinary phase elapsed time relative to Dell CLOCK_MONOTONIC, conditional on fixed-divider continuity and rate stability; raw CPU cycle/TIME/nominal ns retained separately.
not_allowed: Exact point Hz from intended 50MHz/25MHz or CPU:TIME ratio
Unconditional stage physical duration from three sampled averages
SI accuracy without independent Dell reference error bound
Pure DMA/translation delay from phase() stamps
